races.verdict: A match on paper between last year's winner PERSEUS WAY and Clocker , with preference for the former having completed a cross-code hat-trick this summer. Back from a break, he can get the better of Ed Bethell's 3-y-o filly, who has won 2 of her last 3 starts and is heading in the right direction. Ebony Maw looks best of the rest. PERSEUS WAY (IRE) CLOCKER EBONY MAW

races.verdict: Having been placed on all 4 starts this season, KOKO BLUE is selected to open her account having paid for racing closest to the winner when third at Lingfield last month. Love You More 's achilles' heel is her slow starts, but she can give the selection most to think about if on a going day, with Millbuie rounding off the shortlist. KOKO BLUE LOVE YOU MORE MILLBUIE

races.verdict: Preference is for HONOUR YOUR DREAMS , who showed better signs reverting to making the running at Ffos Las on his latest outing. He is fancied to take advantage of his career-low mark this time around, at the expense of the consistent Sisters In The Sky and Rogue Rebellion . races.verdict: JUST ADAIR is fully exposed by now but is more reliable than most at this level and can score for the first time this year. Basilette and Fram Castle also arrive on the back of positive efforts and make most appeal as alternatives. JUST ADAIR BASILETTE (IRE) FRAM CASTLE (IRE)

races.verdict: TIMURSHAH has thrived over hurdles for Aidan Melia and it's worth giving him a chance to show he can also translate that improvement to the Flat. Murat has made a positive start to his Flat career and is second choice ahead of Not Just Any Eagle , Cala Gracioneta and Friary Road . TIMURSHAH (IRE) MURAT (IRE) NOT JUST ANY EAGLE (IRE)

races.verdict: MOYASSR 's latest run in claiming company needs forgiving, yet he'd previously been shaping better than recent form figures suggest and is afforded another chance back on his last winning mark starting out for Ado McGuinness. races.display_title: Navan Racing Festival 14th & 15th November Handicap
races.verdict: A competitive, big-field handicap. DALER has been holding his form well since doubling his career tally at Leopardstown in June and looks a solid proposition off top weight. Zaraahmando , No More Porter and Anvika are all shortlisted. DALER (IRE) ZARAAHMANDO (IRE) NO MORE PORTER (IRE)
